trial_court: High Court of Judicature at Patna, Cr.Misc. No.929 of 2010
case_name: Surendra Kumar Gupta vs The State Of Bihar

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Surendra Kumar Gupta, son of Sri Chhatu Lal Gupta

facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks bail in a case instituted for the offence under Sections 420, 341, 323, 387, 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections ¾ of Dowry Prohibition Act.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the petitioner to establish that he is not a flight risk.
legal_principles.held: Taking into consideration the statement of the girl given in the Family Court in the Divorce Proceedings under Section 13B of Hindu Marriage Act as also that the petitioner is in custody since 7.9.2009,

legal_principles.principle: A bail application can be granted if the petitioner is in custody and there are no grounds to believe that he will not appear before the court.
legal_principles.held: Let the petitioner above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 5,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Patna,

outcome.final_order: Petitioner released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 5,000/- with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Patna.

use_for_drafting: divorce proceedings under Hindu Marriage Act
